meta.title: Vendor cannot place a commercial bid for a regretted item
gaps: Create or verify that a vendor regretted a specific line item in the Technical Stage.
Enter a price only for the specific regretted item and assert that item-level entry or submission is blocked.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Create or verify that a vendor regretted a specific line item in the Technical Stage.; Enter a price only for the specific regretted item and assert that item-level entry or submission is blocked.

steps.note: Open the existing event with the commercial stage available.
Act as the invited vendor in the supplier portal.
Open the commercial RFQ/RA bid sheet.
Attempt to submit a commercial bid and require the portal to refuse it; this is the closest available check, though vendor_bid cannot limit the attempt to the regretted item.
